subject: Mobile Development
title: Ad Fraud on Mobile
description: A quick win: understand Ad Fraud on Mobile.

hook.text: Advertisers lose an estimated $65 billion per year to ad fraud. Mobile is the biggest target.

buildup.text: Click farms use hundreds of real phones to generate fake ad clicks and fake app installs.

discovery.text: SDK spoofing fakes app installs entirely in software, stealing advertiser budgets silently.

twist.text: Some fraudulent apps display invisible ads — users never see them, but advertisers still pay.

climax.text: Ad fraud is one of the most profitable forms of cybercrime, and it's growing every year.

punchline.text: Billions in ad spending goes to fake clicks.

quiz.question: What is SDK spoofing?
options: Faking app installs entirely in software
